items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: So after I left, they got Zutty Singleton. Zutty lasted about three months.

ctx.x: So you weren't New Orleans enough for them.

No. So after I left, they got Zutty Singleton. Zutty lasted about three months. After they got rid of him, there was another drummer who tried it, couldn't make it. Then Wilbur called me and wanted me to come back in the band. And I said, 'Unh-uh. Once I'm... You fire me one time, you won't have a chance to fire me a second time. I don't want to come back no more.' So I didn't go back.
